test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Your district is exposed to ______ and also to destructive floods.
solution: The correct answer is: drought [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Let's look at the meaning of the given words. • Draught means a flow of cold air that comes into a room. (ठंडी हवा का प्रवाह जो एक कमरे में आता है) • Dot means a small, round mark, like a full stop. (एक छोटा, गोल निशान, एक पूर्ण विराम की तरह) • Drought means a prolonged period of dry weather; or lack of rain. (शुष्क मौसम की लंबी अवधि; बारिश की कमी) • Draft means a piece of writing, etc. which will probably be changed and improved; not the final version. (लेखन का एक टुकड़ा, आदि जो शायद बदला और सुधार किया जाएगा; अंतिम संस्करण नहीं) • The implied meaning of the sentence is: Both devastating floods and famine are possible in your region. • So, as per the meaning of the given words, "drought" should be used in the given sentence. Therefore, the correct answer is option 3. Complete sentence: *Your district is exposed to drought __and also to destructive floods. * 42:Ta16, The correctly spelt word is: **Narrative**
